freePlan.title: Free
freePlan.description: Access to everything in Hello Cal except Hello Doc. Only the last 30 days of history are shown — older data is kept and comes back if you go Serious.

seriousPlan.title: Serious
seriousPlan.description: Full history with no 30-day limit, plus access to Hello Doc.
seriousPlan.upgradeUnavailable: Payment isn't connected yet — use a gift code or redeem points to go Serious until a payment provider is in place.

subscription.retentionNote: Data older than 30 days is never deleted — it's kept and shown again as soon as you go Serious.

weightCalibration.title: Weight calibration
weightCalibration.intro: Weigh yourself at different times and under different conditions — this gives you a sense of your fluctuation throughout the day, without having to weigh yourself naked every time.

bodyMeasurements.title: Body measurements
bodyMeasurements.intro: Log your body measurements alongside your weight — they often change before the scale does, giving a fuller picture of your body over time.

account.newsletterIntro: Hello Cal does not know your email. To receive newsletters, sign up separately — the signup is not linked to your account.
account.newsletterSent: Check your email to confirm the signup.
account.pushOnlyHint: Hello Cal does not know your email, so messages are only sent as push.
account.networkError: Something went wrong — check your connection and try again
account.loginIntro: Hello Cal uses passkeys instead of passwords. You log in with Face ID, fingerprint or your device PIN.
account.loginPrivacy: Your data is encrypted on your device. Neither we nor anyone else can read it.
account.loginFailed: Could not log in with passkey
account.noPasskeySupport: Your browser does not support passkeys. Update your browser or use another device.
account.signupIntro: Enter your email. We will send you a link to create your account.
account.signupEmailNote: We do not store your email address — only an unrecognisable fingerprint of it, so you can recover access later.
account.checkMailBody: If the address is valid, we have sent you a link. It works for 30 minutes.
account.confirmIntro: Your device will now create a passkey for Hello Cal. It also unlocks your encrypted vault.
account.linkMissing: The link is invalid or has expired. Start over.
account.recoveryFileIntro: If you lose all your devices, this file is the only way back to your data. Keep it somewhere safe, e.g. in your email or a cloud folder.
account.recoveryFileWarning: Without the file, neither you nor we can open your data again.
account.recoveryFileSplit: The file only works together with the Hello Cal half, which we only release after you have confirmed your identity with support.
account.passkeyDeviceOnly: Your browser cannot use the passkey to unlock your data on other devices. The key is only stored on this device — keep the recovery file safe.
account.recoverIntro: Enter the email you created the account with. We will send you a link.
account.recoverChooseTitle: How do you want to recover?
account.haveFileNote: You open a case. Once support has confirmed your identity, you can open your data again.
account.fileInvalid: This is not a valid Hello Cal recovery file
account.noFile: I have neither a device nor the file
account.noFileNote: You can start over with an empty account. Your old data can never be opened again — not even by us.
account.startOver: Start over with an empty account
account.startOverConfirm: Are you sure? Your old data will never be accessible again.
account.caseInstructions: Contact Hello Cal support with the case number and your email. We confirm it is you and approve the case.
account.approvedIntro: The case is approved. Choose your recovery file again and create a new passkey.
account.lockedTitle: Your data is locked on this device
account.lockedBody: You are logged in, but the key to your data is not on this device. Use recovery to unlock it.
account.deleteAccountConfirm: Are you sure? Your data is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.
